G4901.def:
συν-επι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ 
to join in attesting, bear witness together with: Hébreux 2:4 (Arist., Polyb., a1.).†

G4902.def:
συν-έπομαι 
[in LXX: 2Ma.15:2, 3Ma.5:48 R 3Ma.6:21 * ;] 
to follow with, accompany: with dative of person(s), Actes 20:4.†

G4903.def:
συνεργέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: I Esther 7:2, 1Ma.12:1 * ;] 
__1. prop., to work together (with): absol., Marc 16:20, 1 Corinthiens 16:16, 2 Corinthiens 6:1; with dative, Jacques 2:22; dative commod., Romains 8:28, T, R, txt. (but see infr.). 
__2. In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l): with accusative of thing(s), Romains 8:28 [WH] R, mg. (but see supr.).†

G4904.def:
συνεργός, -όν 
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:7 Mac 14:5 * ;] 
a fellow-worker: with genitive of person(s), Romains 16:3, 9 16:21, Philippiens 2:25 4:3, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:2, Rec., Phm 1 24; θεοῦ (cf. Lft., Notes, 41, 188), 1 Corinthiens 3:9 (pl.), 1 Thessaloniciens 3:2 [WH] R, mg. (R, txt., διάκονον τοῦ θ.; on the original reading, see ICC, in l); τ. χαρᾶς ὑηῶν, 2 Corinthiens 1:24; τ. ἀληθείᾳ, III Jn 8; before εἰς, 2 Corinthiens 8:23, Colossiens 4:11.†

G4905.def:
συν-έρχομαι 
[in LXX for הָלַךְ, בּוֹא, אָסַף ni., etc. ;] 
__1. (cl.) to come together, assemble: Marc 3:20 14:53, T, WH, txt., Actes 1:6 2:6 10:27 16:13 19:32 21:22 22:30 28:17, 1 Corinthiens 14:26; before εἰς, with accusative loc., Actes 5:16; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, 1 Corinthiens 11:20 14:23; with dative of person(s), Marc 14:53, WH, mg., R (πρὸς αὐτόν, see Field, Notes, 40), Jean 11:33; ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, 1 Corinthiens 11:18; ἐνθάδε, Actes 25:17; Marc 6:33, WH, mg. (cf. WH, Intr., 95 ff.); ὅπου, Jean 18:20; with inf., Luc 5:15; εἰς τ. φαγεῖν, 1 Corinthiens 11:33; εἰς τ. ἧσσον, 1 Corinthiens 11:17 11:34; of sexual intercourse (Xen., al.; γυναικί or absol.), Matthieu 1:18. 
__2. In later sense (see exx. in Milligan, Selections, 64, 105), to accompany: with dative of person(s), Luc 23:55, Actes 1:21 9:39 10:23, 45 11:12; before σύν, Actes 21:16; εἰς, Actes 15:38.†

G4906.def:
συν-εσθίω 
[in LXX: Genèse 43:32, Exode 18:12 (אָכַל), 4Ki.12:17 (בָּרָה), Psaumes 101:5 * ;] 
to eat with one: with dative of person(s), Luc 15:2, Actes 10:41 11:3, 1 Corinthiens 5:11; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Galates 2:12.†

G4907.def:
σύνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּינָה and cogn. forms, מַשְׂכִּית, דַּעַת, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;] 
__1. a running or flowing together (Hom.). 
__2. (a) understanding: Luc 2:47, 1 Corinthiens 1:19" (LXX), Éphésiens 3:4, Colossiens 1:9 2:2, 2 Timothée 2:7 
__(b) the understanding, the mind or intelligence: Marc 12:33.†
SYN.: see: σοφία

G4908.def:
συνετός, ή, -όν
(συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּין, חָכָם, etc. ;] 
intelligent, sagacious, understanding: Matthieu 11:25, Luc 10:21, Actes 13:7, 1 Corinthiens 1:19" (LXX) .†

G4909.def:
συν-ευ-δοκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Ma.1:57, 1Ma.4:28 א1, 2Ma.11:24 2Mac 11:35 * ;] 
to join in approving, consent, agree to or with: absol., Actes 22:20; with dative of person(s), Romains 1:32; with dative of thing(s), Luc 11:48, Actes 8:1; with inf., 1 Corinthiens 7:12-13 (chiefly in late writers).†

G4910.def:
συν-ευωχέω, -ῶ 
to entertain together. Pass., to fare sumptuously or feast together or with: Ju 12; with dative of person(s), 2 Pierre 2:13 (Arist., Luc., al.).†

G4911.def:
συν-εφ-ίστημι 
to place over. Pass., 
__1. to stand over (Thuc.). 
__2. to rise together: before κατά, with genitive of person(s) (against), Actes 16:22.†

G4913.def:
συν-ήδομαι 
to rejoice together; with dative, to rejoice with or in: τ. νόμῳ τ. θεοῦ, Romains 7:22 (see Lft., Notes, 304).†

G4914.def:
συνήθεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἦθος), [in LXX: 4Ma.2:12 4Mac 6:13 4Mac 13:22 4Mac 13:27 * ;] 
__1 1 intimacy. 
__2. habit, custom: Jean 18:39, 1 Corinthiens 11:16; with genitive obj. (cf. Æschin., 23, 37, and see MM, xxiv), habitual use, force of habit with respect to, 1 Corinthiens 8:7.†

G4915.def:
συν-ηλικιώτης
(ἡλικία), = συνῆλιζ (Æsch.), 
one of the same age, an equal in age: Galates 1:14.†

G4916.def:
συν-θάπτω 
to bury together with: in symbolical sense, of baptism, σὐτῷ (with Christ), Romains 6:4, Colossiens 2:12.†

G4917.def:
συν-θλάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for מָחַץ etc. ;] 
to crush together, crush: Matthieu 21:44 ([WH], R, mg., om.), Luc 20:18.†

G4918.def:
συν-θλίβω 
[in LXX: Ecclésiaste 12:6 א A (רָצַץ), Sir.34:14 (31:14), 1Ma.15:14 A * ;] 
to press together, press on all sides: Marc 5:24, 31.†

G4919.def:
συν-θρύπτω 
to break in pieces, crush: metaphorically, τ. καρδίαν, Actes 21:13.†

G4920.def:
συν-ίημι and συνίω (see Bl., § 23, 7), 
[in LXX chiefly for בִּין hi., שָׂכַל hi. ;] 
__1. to bring or set together. 
__2. Metaphorical, to perceive, understand: Matthieu 13:13-15 (LXX), Matthieu 13:19 15:10, Marc 4:9 (WH, mg.), Marc 4:12 7:14 8:17, 21 Luc 8:10, Actes 7:25 28:26-27, Romains 15:21" (LXX), 2 Corinthiens 10:12; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 13:23, 51, Luc 2:50 18:34 24:45; before ὅτι, Matthieu 16:12 17:13; before quæst. indir., Éphésiens 5:17; ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, Marc 6:52; as subst., συνίων (ὁ σ., WH, mg.), a man of understanding, i.e. in moral and religious sense, Romains 3:11 (LXX).†

G4922.def:
συν-οδεύω 
[in LXX: Zacharie 8:21 א1 (הָלַךְ), Tob.5:16 א, Wis.6:23 * ;] 
to journey with: with dative of person(s), Actes 9:7 (Plut., al.).†

G4923.def:
συνοδία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX: Néhémie 7:5, 64 (יָחַשׂ) * ;] 
__1. a journey in company (Plut., al.). 
__2. By meton., κ company of travellers, a caravan: Luc 2:44.†

G4924.def:
συν-οικέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for בַּעַל etc. ;] 
to dwell together: of man and wife (Hdt., al.), with dative of person(s), 1 Pierre 3:7,†

G4925.def:
συν-οίκοδομέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: I Esther 5:68 * ;] 
__1. to build together or with (with dative of person(s), 1Esdras, l.with). 
__2. Of various materials, to build up together (Thuc., al.): metaphorically, of Christians, Éphésiens 2:22.†

G4926.def:
συν-ομιλέω, -ῶ 
to converse with (absol., FlJ, Bl, v, 13, 1; before μετά, Cebes, 13): with dative of person(s), Actes 10:27.†

G4927.def:
συν-ομορέω, -ῶ 
to border on: with dative, Actes 18:7 (Byz.).†

G4928.def:
συν-οχή, -ῆς, ή
(συνέχω), [in LXX: Juges 2:3 (?), Job 30:3 (שׁוֹא), Job 38:28 A; Michée 5:1 (4:14), Jérémie 52:5 (מָצוֹר) * ;] 
__1. a holding or being held together. 
__2. a narrow place (Hom., al.). Metaphorical, straits, distress: Luc 21:25; καρδίας, 2 Corinthiens 2:4.†

G4929.def:
συν-τάσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] 
to prescribe, ordain, arrange: with dative of person(s), Matthieu 21:6 26:19 27:10" (LXX) .†

G4930.def:
συντέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(συντελέω), [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קוּם ;] 
__1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.). 
__2. In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Dan LXX TH Daniel 12:13, al.), Matthieu 13:39-40, 49 24:3 28:20, Hébreux 9:26.†

G4931.def:
συν-τελέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה pi., also for עָשָׂה, תָּמַם, etc. ;] 
"perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118), 
__1. to complete, finish, bring to an end: Luc 4:13; pass., Luc 4:2, Jean 2:3, WH, mg., Actes 21:27. 
__2. to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): Marc 13:4, Romains 9:28, Hébreux 8:8.†

G4932.def:
συν-τέμνω 
[in LXX chiefly for חָרַץ ;] 
__1. to cut in pieces. 
__2. to cut down, cut short: metapb., λόγον, Romains 9:28 (LXX) (Hdt., Plat., Fur., al.).†

G4933.def:
συν-τηρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Eze.18:19 (שָׁמַר), Da TH Daniel 7:28 A (נְטַר), Sir.13:12 and freq., Tob.1:11, 2Ma.12:42, al. ;] 
"perfective" of τηρέω (see M, Pr., 113, 116), 
to preserve, keep safe, keep close: with accusative of person(s), Marc 6:20; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 9:17; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Luc 2:19 (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).†

G4934.def:
συν-τίθημι 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 22:13 (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] 
to place or put together, in various senses. Mid., 
__(a) to observe, perceive; 
__(b) to determine, agree, covenant: with inf., Luc 22:5; before τοῦ, with inf., Actes 23:20; before ἵνα, Jean 9:22.†
συν-επι-τίθημι, 
[in LXX for שִׁית, etc. ;] 
to help in putting on. Mid., to join in attacking (Thuc.): Actes 24:9 (RV, joined in the charge).†

G4935.def:
συν-τόμως, 
adv. (συντέμνω) [in LXX: Proverbes 13:23 23:28, 3Ma.5:25 * ;] 
concisely, briefly: Actes 24:4 (for a similar ex., see MM, xxiv).†

G4936.def:
συν-τρέχω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 50:18 (עִם רָצָה), עִם רָצָה), 2Ma.2:1-32, Jdt.4.1-15 * ;] 
to run together or with: before ἐκεῖ, Marc 6:33; πρόσ, with accusative, Actes 3:11; metaphorically, 1 Pierre 4:4.†

G4937.def:
συν-τρίβω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁבַר ;] 
to shatter, break in pieces: Matthieu 12:20 (LXX), Marc 5:4 14:3, Jean 19:36" (LXX), Apocalypse 2:27; of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: Luc 9:39; figuratively, Romains 16:20.†

G4938.def:
σύν-τριμμα, -τος, τό
(συντρίβω), [in LXX (Lévitique 21:19, al.) chiefly for שֶׁבֶר; also for שֹׁד (Ésaïe 59:7), etc. ;] 
a fracture (Arist.; Le, l.with, al.). Metaphorical, calamity, destruction (Isa, l.with, Wis.3:3, al.): Romains 3:16" (LXX) .†

G4939.def:
σύν-τροφος, -ου, ὁ
(συντρέφομαι, to be brought up together) [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24, 1Ma.1:6 R, 2Ma.9:29 * ;] 
__1. prop., one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother: Actes 13:1 EV. 
__2. In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king (see Deiss., BS, 305, 310 f.): Actes 13:1 (cf. also MM, xxiv).†

G4940.def:
συν-τυγχάνω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:14 * ;] 
to meet with, fall in with: with dative of person(s), Luc 8:19.†

G4942.def:
συν-υπο-κρίνομαι 
to play a part with, dissemble with: with dative, Galates 2:13 (Polyb.).†

G4943.def:
συν-υπουργέω, -ῶ 
to help together, join in serving: with dative instr., 2 Corinthiens 1:11.†

G4944.def:
συν-ωδίνω 
to be in travail together (Arist.): metapb. (Eur.), Romains 8:22.†

G4945.def:
συνωμοσία, -ας, ή
(συνόμνυμι, to conspire), [in Sm.: Eze.22:25 * ;] 
a conspiracy: Actes 23:13.†

G4946.def: ionic Συρήκουσαι, doric Συράκοσαι, and Σῦράκοσσαι, Syracuse , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G4947.def:
Συρία, -'ιό, ή 
Syria: Matthieu 4:24, Luc 2:2, Actes 15:23, 41 18:18 20:3 21:3, Galates 1:21.†

G4948.def:
Σύρος, -ου, ὁ, fem. Σύρα 
a Syrian: Luc 4:27, Marc 7:26, WH, mg.†

G4949.def:
Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ 
a Syropænician woman: Marc 7:26, WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).†

G4950.def:
Σύρτις (L, σῦρτις), -εως, accusative -ιν, ἡ, 
Syrtis, the name of two large sand-banks on the Libyan coast: Actes 27:17.†

G4951.def:
σύρω 
[in LXX: 4Ki.17:13 (סָחַב), 4Ma.6:1, al. ;] 
to draw, drag: with accusative of thing(s), Jean 21:8, Apocalypse 12:4; with accusative of person(s), of taking to trial or punish­ment, Actes 8:3; ἔξω τ. πόλεως, Actes 14:19; ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. 4Mac, l.with), Actes 17:6 (cf. κατα-ούρω).†

G4952.def:
συ-σπαράσσω 
to convulse completely: with accusative of person(s), Marc 9:20, Luc 9:42 (cf. σπαράσσω).†

G4953.def:
σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό 
(σῆμα), [in LXX: Juges 20:38, 40 (מַשְׂאֵת), Ésaïe 5:26 49:22 62:10 (נֵס) * ;] 
a fixed sign or signal: Marc 14:44. (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) †

G4954.def:
σύν-σωμος (Rec. συσσ-), -ον 
(σῶμα), 
of the same body: Éphésiens 3:6 (Eccl.).†

G4955.def:
στασιαστής
(στασιάζω, to stir up sedition, Jdth.7:15, 2Ma.4:30 2Mac 14:6 *) 
= Att.. στασιώτης, 
a rebel, revolutionist, one who stirs up sedition: Marc 15:7 (FlJ, al.).†
συ-στασιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ, 
a fellow-rioter: Marc 15:7, Rec.†

G4956.def:
συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν 
(συνίστημι), 
__1. for putting together, constructive. 
__2. for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and see MM, xxiv), 2 Corinthiens 3:1.†

G4957.def:
συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, 
to crucify together with: pass., with dative, Jean 19:32; id. before σύν, Matthieu 27:44, Marc 15:32. Metaphorical, of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: Romains 6:6, Galates 2:20 (Eccl.).†

G4958.def:
συν-στέλλω
(Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: Juges 8:28 11:33 (כָּנַע ni.), Sir.4:31, al. ;] 
__1. to draw together, contract, shorten: of time, 1 Corinthiens 7:29. 
__2. to wrap up: of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), with accusative, Actes 5:6.†

G4959.def:
συν-στενάζω (Rec. συσ-), 
to groan together or with: Romains 8:22 (with dative of person(s), Eur., Ion., 935).†

G4960.def:
συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, 
to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaphorical, to correspond to: Galates 4:25 (see Lft., in l).†

G4961.def:
συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ 
a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaphorical, of fellowship in Christian service: Philippiens 2:25, Phm 2 .†

G4962.def:
συ-στέφω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָשַׁר ;] 
__1. to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), Actes 28:3. 
__2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Matthieu 17:22 (WH, R, mg.).†

G4963.def:
συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(συστρέφω), [in LXX: Romains 4:19 13:12 (צָרַר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Amos 7:10 (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] 
__1. a twisting together (Plat.). 
__2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Actes 19:40; σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.with), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Actes 23:12.†

G4964.def:
συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-), 
(σχῆμα), 
to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: Romains 12:2, 1 Pierre 1:14.†

G4965.def:
Συχάρ
(Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ 
Sychar, a town of Samaria: Jean 4:5.†

G4966.def:
Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם), 
Shechem; 
__1. the son of Hamor (Genèse 33:19): Actes 7:16 b, Rec. 
__2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Actes 7:16 a,b.†

G4967.def:
σφαγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(σφάζω), [in LXX for טָבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc. ;] 
slaughter: Actes 8:32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Romains 8:36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Jacques 5:5.†

G4968.def:
σφάγιον, -ου, τό
(σφαγή), [in LXX: Amos 5:25 (זֶבַח), Eze.21:10, 15 21:28 (טֶבַח), Lévitique 22:23 (נְדָבָה) * ;] 
a victim for slaughter: Actes 7:42 (LXX).†

G4969.def:
σφάζω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט ;] 
to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Apocalypse 5:6, 12 13:8; of persons, 1 Jean 3:12, Apocalypse 5:9 6:4, 9 18:24; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Apocalypse 13:3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).†

G4970.def:
σφόδρα adv. (prop. neut. of σφοδρός, excessive, violent) 
[in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד ;] 
very, very much, exceedingly: with verbs, Matthieu 17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54, Actes 6:7; with adjectives, Matthieu 2:10, Marc 16:4, Luc 18:23, Apocalypse 16:21.†

G4973.def:
σφραγίς, -ῖδος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Exode 28:11, al. (חוֹתָם) Exode 35:22 (חָח), Sir.17:22, al. ;] 
__1. a seal, signet: Apocalypse 7:2. 
__2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, see: σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, Apocalypse 5:1-2, 5 5:9 6:1, 3 6:5, 7 6:9, 12 8:1; metaphorically, Romains 4:11, 1 Corinthiens 9:2, 2 Timothée 2:19, Apocalypse 9:4.†

G4974.def:
σφυρόν, -οῦ, τό, 
[in LXX: Job 41:21 (לָהַט) * ;] 
the ankle: Actes 3:7, Rec. (T, WH, σφυδρόν; see Bl., § 6, 8).†

G4975.def:
σχέδον
adv. (ἔχω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:2, 3Ma.5:14 3Mac 5:45 * ;] 
__1. of place, near. 
__2. Of degree, almost, nearly: Actes 13:44 19:26, Hébreux 9:22.†

G4976.def:
σχῆμα, -τος, τό
(ἔχω), [in LXX: Ésaïe 3:17 (פֹּת) * ;] 
figure, fashion: 1 Corinthiens 7:31, Philippiens 2:8.†
SYN.: see: μορφή

G4977.def:
σχίζω 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע ;] 
to cleave, rend: Matthieu 27:51, Marc 1:10 15:38, Luc 5:36 23:45, Jean 19:24 21:11; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, Actes 14:4 23:7.†

G4978.def:
σχίσμα, -τος, τό
(σχίζω), 
a rent (Arist., al.): Matthieu 9:16, Marc 2:21. Metaphorical, a dissension, division: Jean 7:43 9:16 10:19, 1 Corinthiens 1:10 11:18 12:25.†
SYN.: see: αἵρεσις

G4979.def:
σχοινίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), 
[in LXX chiefly for a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jean 2:15, Actes 27:32.†

G4980.def:
σχολάζω
(σχολή), [in LXX: Exode 5:8, 17, Psaumes 46:10 (רָפָה ni., hi.) * ;] 
to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in: 1 Corinthiens 7:5; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, Matthieu 12:44, Luc 11:25 (T [WH], R, om.).†

G4981.def:
σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Genèse 33:14 (κατὰ σ., אַט), Proverbes 28:19, Sir.38:24 * ;] 
__1. leisure. 
__2. Later (from Plato on), 
__(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture; 
__(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Actes 19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).†

G4982.def:
σώζω (on the more accurate σῴζω, see WH, Intr., §410; Bl., §3, 1-3), 
[in LXX chiefly for ישׁע hi., also for מלט ni., נצל ni., etc. ;] 
to save from peril, injury or suffering: Matthieu 8:25, Marc 13:20, Luc 23:35, al.; τ. ψυχήν, Matthieu 16:25, al.; before ἐκ, Jean 12:27, Hébreux 5:7, Ju 5; of healing, restoring to health: Matthieu 9:22, Marc 5:34, al. In NT, esp. of salvation from spiritual disease and death, in which sense it is "spoken of in Scripture as either (1) past, (2) present, or (3) future, according as redemption, grace, or glory is the point in view. Thus (1) Romains 8:24, Éphésiens 2:5, 8 2 Timothée 1:9, Tite 3:5; (2) Actes 2:47, 1 Corinthiens 1:18, 15:2, 2 Corinthiens 2:15; (3) Matthieu 10:22, Romains 13:11, Philippiens 2:12, Hébreux 9:28" (Vau. on Romains 5:9). Seq. ἀπό, Matthieu 1:21, Actes 2:40, Romains 5:9; ἐκ, Jacques 5:20, Ju 23 (cf. Cremer, 532ff.).

G4983.def:
σῶμα, -τος, τό, 
[in LXX for גְּוִיָּה ,בָּשָׂר, etc., and for Aram. נְבֵלָה ;] 
a body. 
__1. Prop., of the human body, 
__(a) as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: Matthieu 27:58, 59 Marc 15:43, al.; 
__(b) of the living body: Luc 11:34, 1 Corinthiens 6:13, al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, Hébreux 13:3; as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., 2 Corinthiens 5:10; opposite to πνεῦμα, Romains 8:10, 1 Corinthiens 5:3 7:4, Jacques 2:26; to ψυχή, Matthieu 6:25 10:28, Luc 12:22 (cf. Wis.1:1, al.); to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., 1 Thessaloniciens 5:23; σ. ψυχικόν, opposite to σ. πνευματικόν, 1 Corinthiens 15:44; ὁ ναὸς τοῦ σ. αὐτοῦ (genitive epexeg.), Jean 2:21; τὸ σ. τ. ταπεινώσεως (Hebraistic "genitive of definition"; M, Pr., 73f.; Bl., §35, 5), opposite to τὸ σ. τ. δοξῆς αὐτοῦ, Philippiens 3:21; similarly, τὸ σ. τ. σαρκός, Colossiens 1:22; σ. τοῦ θανάτου (subject to death), Romains 7:24; σ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, Romains 6:6; 
__(with) periphr., ἀνθρώπου, then absol., σῶμα (Soph., Xen., al.), a person, and in later writers (Polyb., al.), a slave: Apocalypse 18:13 (cf. MM, i, ii, xxiv; Deiss., BS, 160). 
__2. Of the bodies of animals: living, Jacques 3:3; dead, Hébreux 13:11 ( Exode 29:14, al.). 
__3. Of inanimate objects (cf. Eng. "heavenly bodies"): 1 Corinthiens 15:37, 38 40 (Diod., al.). 
__4. Of any corporeal substance (Plat., al.): opposite to σκιά, Colossiens 2:17. Metaphorical, of a number of persons united by a common bond; in NT, of the Church as the spiritual body of Christ: Romains 12:5, 1 Corinthiens 10:16, 17 12:13, 27, Éphésiens 1:23 2:16 4:4, 12, 16 5:23, 30, Colossiens 1:18, 24 2:19 3:15; ἓν σ. κ. ἓν πνεῦμα, Éphésiens 4:4.

G4984.def:
σωματικός, -ή, -όν
(σῶμα), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:32 4Mac 3:1 * ;] 
__(a) of or for the body, bodily: γυμνασία, 1 Timothée 4:8; 
__(b) (opposite to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal: εἶδος, Luc 3:22.†

G4985.def:
σωματικῶς 
adv., 
bodily, corporeally: Colossiens 2:9 (see ICC, Lft., in l).†

G4987.def:
σωρεύω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 25:22 (חָתָה), Jdth.15:11 * ;] 
__(a) to heap on: with accusative before ἐπί with accusative, Romains 12:20 (LXX) (Arist., al.); 
__(b) to heap with: with accusative and dative, metaphorically, ἁμαρτίαις, 2 Timothée 3:6 (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes, 217) (Polyb.).†

G4990.def:
σωτήρ, -ῆρος, ὁ
(σώζω), [in LXX for יָשַׁע and cognate forms ;] 
saviour, deliverer, preserver, a frequently epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE, 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT, 
__(a) of God (as LXX: Psaumes 24:5, Ésaïe 12:2, al.): Luc 1:47, 1 Timothée 1:1 2:3 4:10, Tite 1:3 2:10 3:4, Ju 25; 
__(b) of Christ: Luc 2:11, Actes 5:31 13:23, Philippiens 3:20; τ. κόσμου, Jean 4:42, 1 Jean 4:14 (for the general use of the word, see Westc., in l); ἡμῶν, 2 Timothée 1:10, Tite 1:4 3:6; θεὸς (κύριος) καὶ σ. (see Deiss., LAE, 348.4; M, Pr., 84), Tite 2:13, 2 Pierre 1:1 1:11 2:20 3:2 3:18; σ. τοῦ σώματος (i.e. of the Church; see: σῶμα, 5), Éphésiens 5:23.†

G4991.def:
σωτηρία, -ας, ἡ
(σωτήρ), [in LXX for יֶשַׁע, יְשׁוּעָה, תְּשׁוּעָה, פְּלֵיטָה, etc. ;] 
deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): Actes 7:25 27:34, Hébreux 11:7; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, Luc 1:71. In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (see: σώζω): Luc 19:9, Jean 4:22, Actes 4:12 13:47, Romains 11:11, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:13, 2 Timothée 3:15, Hébreux 2:3 6:9, 2 Pierre 3:15, Ju 3; opposite to ἀπηώλεια, Philippiens 1:28; αἰώνιος-., Hébreux 5:9; ὁ λόγος (τὸ εὐαγγέλιον) τῆς σ., Actes 13:26, Éphésiens 1:13; ὁδὸς σωτηρίας, Actes 16:17; κέρας σωτηρίας, Luc 1:69; ἡμέρα σωτηρίας, 2 Corinthiens 6:2 (LXX); κατεργάζεσθαι τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σ., Philippiens 2:12; κληρονομεῖν σ., Hébreux 1:14; ὁ ἀρχηγὸς τῆς σ., Hébreux 2:10; εἰς σ., Romains 1:16 10:1, 10, 1 Pierre 2:2; σ. as a present possession (see: σώζω), Luc 1:77, 2 Corinthiens 1:6 7:10, Philippiens 1:19, 2 Timothée 2:10; as more fully realized in the future: Romains 13:11, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:8-9, Hébreux 9:28, 1 Pierre 1:5 1:9-10, Apocalypse 7:10 12:10 19:1.†

G4992.def:
σωτήριος, -ον
(σωτήρ), [in LXX for יְשׁוּעָה, שֶׁלֶם, etc. ;] 
saving, bringing salvation, in NT always in spiritual sense (see: σώζω, σωτηρία): ἡ χάρις ἡ σ., Tite 2:1. Neut., -τὸ σ., as subst. (cl.), salvation: Luc 2:30; τ. σ. τ. θεοῦ, Luc 3:6, Actes 28:28; περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σ., Éphésiens 6:17.†

G4993.def:
σωφρονέω, -ῶ
(σώφρων), 
__(a) to be of sound mind or in one's right mind: Marc 5:15, Luc 8:35; opposite to ἐκστῆναι, 2 Corinthiens 5:13 (Hdt.); 
__(b) to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opposite to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; sch., Thuc., al.): Tite 2:6; opposite to ὑπερφρονεῖν, Romains 12:3; σ. καὶ νήφειν, 1 Pierre 4:7.†

G4994.def:
σωφρονίζω 
[in Aq.: Ésaïe 38:16 * ;] 
to make σώφρων, recall one to his senses, control (RV, train): with accusative of person(s), Tite 2:4.†

G4995.def:
σωφρονισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(σωφρονίζω), 
__(a) an admonishing (F1J, Plut., al.); 
__(b) self-control, self-discipline: 2 Timothée 1:7 (on the reflexive meaning here, see Ellic., in l).†

G4996.def:
σωφρόνως 
adv., [in LXX: Wis.9:11 * ;] 
with sound mind, prudently, soberly: Tite 2:12.†

G4997.def:
σωφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Esther 3:13, Wis.8:7, 2Ma.4:37, 4Ma.6:1-35 * ;] 
__(a) soundness of mind, good sense, sanity (opposite to μανία, Xen.): Actes 26:25; 
__(b) self-control, sobriety: 1 Timothée 2:9 (see Tr., Syn., § xx), 1 Timothée 2:15.†

G4998.def:
σώφρων, -ον 
[in LXX: 4Ma.9:1-32 * ;] 
__(a) of sound mind, sane, sensible; 
__(b) self-controlled, sober-minded: 1 Timothée 3:2, Tite 1:8 2:2, 5 (Arist.).†

G4999.def:
ταβέρνη
(Lat. taberna), see: Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι. 
Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι 
(see: ταβέρνη), 
Three Taverns (Lit. Tres Tabernae) a halting place on the Appian Way: Actes 28:15 (see DB, iv, 690).†
